Allowed accounts and deterministic replay keys; positive amount; actor/employee lookup; open-day gate before transaction. Transaction locks employee anchor, repeats replay, authorizes employees_ledger, locks employee ledger range and checks owed balance, then locks protected treasury account. Posts movement, Settlement ledger entry, journal and audit in one save/commit. Receipt reasoning matches actual sequence; locked ledger range counters broad claim that distinct-key employee payments can both spend stale employee balance.

Tests source covers same-key replay/concurrency, distinct requests against same employee, one movement and ledger type. Active-employee rule absent; day gate pretransaction.
